priceSnapshot.note: Morning closed the handover at 85,648.0 (06:56 COT) after HOLDing through a second long-liquidation cascade. Since then price fell further and printed a settled 1H close of 84,047.2 (16:00-17:00 UTC / 11:00-12:00 COT) -- a confirmed close that broke not just the 85,325.2 reduce level flagged since midnight/morning but also the 85,111.1 invalidatesAt and the 85,050 stop-order price from the morning report. Price continued to a fresh session low of 83,500.2 before a liquidation-driven bounce back to 84,308.7. Net since morning: -1,339.3 points (-1.56%). Net since midnight's 86,393.2 add: -2,084.5 (-2.41%). Open interest fell 5.3% this session (2,655.7M to 2,514.4M USD) -- unlike the two prior cascades (both of which saw OI rise), this one shows genuine deleveraging, not fresh positioning building underneath.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 83,500.2 (today's session low) would confirm the breakdown is extending past this session's flush rather than the liquidation-driven low holding as support.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close back above 85,111.1 -- the former invalidation level, now the first reclaim hurdle -- would be the first sign this leg is repairing; a full reclaim of 85,325.2 (the level that fired this reduce) would restore the pre-pullback structure.

decisionBox.changed: Downgraded HOLD -> REDUCE. The 85,325.2 reduce trigger set at midnight and held through morning fired with a confirmed settled 1H close at 84,047.2 (16:00-17:00 UTC / 11:00-12:00 COT) -- and price didn't stop there, it also broke the 85,111.1 invalidatesAt and the 85,050 stop-order price flagged at morning, printing a session low of 83,500.2 before a partial bounce to 84,308.7 (roughly +800 points off the low within the same hour). Trimming the tactical midnight tranche (15 USDT added at 86,393.2) rather than the full multi-week core: daily structure (price above every daily EMA, RSI 63.94, MACD histogram still positive at 432.29 though decelerating from 603.70 at morning) stays intact, and OI actually fell this session (real deleveraging) rather than rising as in the prior two cascades, so this reads as a sharp liquidation-amplified flush inside an still-standing daily uptrend rather than a confirmed reversal. But the pre-set invalidation was tagged with a settled close, not just wicked -- letting a second consecutive report slide past a fired reduce level without acting would be the discipline failure the skill warns about, so this session acts on it rather than waiting for a cleaner signal.

liquidation.note: 41,925,600 USD of long liquidations in a single fill -- the dominant cluster of this session's flush (100 fills, 16:05:49-17:23:32 UTC / 11:05-12:23 COT, covering 83,700-84,300). Spent fuel roughly 400 points below current spot (84,308.7), not a resting order.
23,699,029 USD of long liquidations across 36 fills, the low end of the drop toward the 83,500.2 session low. Already discharged.
13,696,009 USD of SHORT liquidations across 9 fills -- the opposite side, discharged earlier in the session as price first pushed up through this zone before reversing lower.
12,139,062 USD of short liquidations across 19 fills, same up-move as the 84,300 cluster.
11,227,973 USD of long liquidations across 19 fills, the deepest point of the flush before the bounce.

liquidityMagnet.note: This session's captured window was two-sided for the first time in a while: 76,900,485 USD of longs vs 31,464,992 USD of shorts (about 2.44-to-1 long-skewed), versus one-sided 13,249-to-1 and 218-to-1 cascades at morning and midnight. Shorts got flushed first as price pushed toward 84,300, then longs got flushed harder on the drop to 83,500.2. No verified magnet sits above current spot right now -- everything captured already discharged below it. OI fell 5.3% through the session (real deleveraging, unlike the prior two cascades where OI rose), which is a more constructive setup for a durable bounce than the last two flushes had.

calibration.rollingRecord: Morning HELD at 85,648.0 with the reduce level (85,325.2) about 115 points away -- the closest it had been tested all week -- rather than trim. Holding through the near-miss at morning did not help; the level fired anyway and travelled further than the morning report's own stop-order price. Midnight's 15 USDT tranche (entry 86,393.2) is now about 2,084 points offside (-2.41%) before this session's reduce.
